patch_description: This design replaces the generic dense CZ connectivity with a sparse, measurement-aligned circuit. A globally shared RY mixer provides a regularized basis change, while shared CRZ gates act directly on the dataset-supplied readout pairs. Because the CRZ layer ends every block, it is also the final trainable operation before measurement after the third repetition. This focuses the single circuit parameter on correlations that directly affect the fixed observable, reduces unnecessary depth and gate count, and preserves the three-total-parameter economy that performed best in prior candidates.
